privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.metaDescription: How Vanillate Convert handles your files: browser processing, automatic deletion and what is logged.
privacy.intro: Your files are yours. This page explains exactly what happens to them.
privacy.browserText: Conversions marked “In your browser” run on your device. The file is read by the page, converted in memory and handed back to you. It is not uploaded.
privacy.serverText: Some conversions need software that cannot run in a browser. For those, the file is uploaded with a one-time link, checked, converted in an isolated environment without network access, and stored only until you download it.
privacy.retentionInput: Your original file is deleted as soon as the conversion finishes.
privacy.retentionOutput: Results are deleted {outputMinutes} minutes after the conversion.
privacy.retentionAbandoned: Uploads that are never converted are deleted after {abandonedMinutes} minutes.
privacy.retentionFailed: Files of failed or cancelled conversions are deleted within {failedMinutes} minutes.
privacy.retentionRecord: A small job record (file names, sizes, formats and status, never contents) is kept up to {recordHours} hours longer, then deleted.
privacy.accessText: Each conversion has a private link that only your browser knows. Download links expire after {linkMinutes} minutes.
privacy.logsText: We log technical events — job IDs, formats, sizes and errors — to keep the service running. We do not log file contents.
privacy.cookiesText: We use one cookie to remember your language. There are no tracking or advertising cookies.

about.title: About Vanillate Convert
about.text: Vanillate Convert is a file conversion and processing platform. Every format, conversion and tool comes from a single registry, so the site only offers what it can actually do, and tells you how well it does it.
